```{python}
import pandas as pd

attractions = pd.read_csv("data/attractions.csv")
top = attractions.loc[attractions["visits_2025"].idxmax()]
top_name = top["attraction"]
top_visits = f"{top['visits_2025']:,}"
total_visits = f"{attractions['visits_2025'].sum():,}"
n_top = len(attractions)
n_free = int(attractions["admission"].str.startswith("Free").sum())
```

## Why London

- In 2025, London's `{python} n_top` most visited ALVA member attractions welcomed
  `{python} total_visits` visits.
- The `{python} top_name` led with `{python} top_visits` visits.
- `{python} n_free` of those `{python} n_top` are free to enter.

## Five sights to start with

| Sight | Price band | Nearest tube | Plan a visit |
|---|---|---|---|
| British Museum | Free | Tottenham Court Road | [britishmuseum.org](https://www.britishmuseum.org/visit) |
| Natural History Museum | Free | South Kensington | [nhm.ac.uk](https://www.nhm.ac.uk/visit.html) |
| Tate Modern | Free | Southwark | [tate.org.uk](https://www.tate.org.uk/visit/tate-modern) |
| National Gallery | Free | Charing Cross | [nationalgallery.org.uk](https://www.nationalgallery.org.uk/visiting) |
| Tower of London | Paid | Tower Hill | [hrp.org.uk](https://www.hrp.org.uk/tower-of-london/visit/) |

"Free" means free general admission; special exhibitions may charge.

## Getting around

Plan every route by Tube, bus or Santander Cycles with the
[TfL Journey Planner](https://tfl.gov.uk/plan-a-journey/).

## Sources

- Visit numbers: [ALVA, visits made in 2025](https://www.alva.org.uk/details.cfm?p=423),
  retrieved 2026-10-30.
- Stations and admission: each sight's official visitor page above, checked 2026-10-30.
